# Security & Cost Requirements Quality Checklist: AWS Deployment for MisiOps

**Purpose**: Unit-test the requirements (spec, plan, research, contracts) for secrets handling, CI identity and least privilege, network exposure, data protection, HTTPS/edge behaviour, the `dev` non-production posture and the cost ceiling
**Created**: 2026-11-07 | **Reviewed**: 2026-11-08 (reviewer: repository team; gaps closed in spec.md, research.md and contracts/deploy-workflow.md the same day)
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Secrets Handling

- [x] CHK001 Are all runtime secrets enumerated with their producer, consumer variable and store name, and is the list closed (nothing else may be a secret)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Data Model §Secret]
- [x] CHK002 Is "MUST NOT appear in the infrastructure definition output" testable, i.e. is the artefact to inspect (synthesized template) and the forbidden content (plaintext values, `SecretString`) named? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, Quickstart §1]
- [x] CHK003 Are the characters excluded from the generated database password specified so the backend's connection string stays valid, and is that rule traceable to a requirement rather than only to research? [Gap, Research §R6, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK004 Is the behaviour on secret rotation specified for both secrets, including that rotating `SECRET_KEY` invalidates every session? [Coverage, Spec US5 scenario 4, Data Model §Secret]
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified which principal may read each secret (task execution role only, scoped to the two ARNs) and that no CI identity may read secret values? [Clarity, Research §R7, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK006 Does the spec state that stack outputs, job summaries and logs must not echo secret values or the deploy role's temporary credentials? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, Contracts deploy-workflow]
- [x] CHK007 Is the list of allowed non-secret repository variables (`AWS_ACCOUNT_ID`, `AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN`, `ALERT_EMAIL`) closed, and is "no secrets added" stated as a requirement rather than a contract note? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, Contracts deploy-workflow]

## CI Identity & Least Privilege

- [x] CHK008 Are the trust conditions of the deploy role fully specified (audience, exact `sub` values for both branch refs and both environments) and is the repository name parameterised rather than hard-coded in the requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK009 Is "limited to the permissions the deployment needs" enumerated as a closed action list (assume CDK bootstrap roles, ECR push/pull on two repositories, describe stacks) so a reviewer can detect scope creep? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK010 Is the accepted risk that the CDK bootstrap execution role keeps administrator permissions recorded with an owner, a review date and the documented mitigation path? [Assumption, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK011 Is the maximum session duration of the deploy role stated as a requirement, and is it consistent with the 15-minute deployment target? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-001, Research §R9]
- [x] CHK012 Is it specified that the production approval must be granted by a human other than the pipeline (named role or group), and what happens if the approver is also the commit author? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK013 Are the one-time administrator steps (bootstrap, Foundation stack, variables, environments) distinguished from the CI role's permissions so that the CI role is never granted bootstrap-level rights? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, Quickstart §2]

## Network Exposure & Edge

- [x] CHK014 Is "only the API's compute MUST be able to open connections" to the database expressed as a verifiable rule (security-group-to-security-group, no CIDR), and is the frontend explicitly excluded? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK015 Is the requirement that the load balancer accepts traffic only from the content delivery layer specified with its mechanism (managed prefix list) and its known limitation (any CloudFront distribution, not only ours, can reach the ALB)? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-008, Research §R3]
- [x] CHK016 Are the compute tasks' public IP addresses (needed without NAT) covered by a requirement stating that no inbound rule other than from the load balancer may exist on them? [Gap, Research §R3]
- [x] CHK017 Is the "no caching of API responses" rule complete: does it cover every API path pattern (`/api/*`, `/openapi.json`, `/docs`, `/redoc`) and error responses, and does it name the forwarded headers (authorization, cookies, content-type)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research §R4]
- [x] CHK018 Is the HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect requirement consistent between the spec (redirect) and the edge default behaviours (all behaviours, including static assets)? [Consistency, Spec §NFR-008, Contracts cdk-stacks]
- [x] CHK019 Are the existing hardening headers (CSP `connect-src 'self'`, `frame-ancestors`, COOP/CORP) required to remain correct when the app is served from the content delivery domain, and is the API origin change (`""`) reflected in the CSP requirement? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Research §R8]
- [x] CHK020 Is the backend's `CORS_ORIGINS` default explicitly declared harmless under same-origin, or is a requirement needed to set it to the public URL? [Ambiguity, Data Model §Runtime configuration]

## Data Protection

- [x] CHK021 Are encryption at rest, backup retention and backup encryption specified for the database in both environments, with the retention value traceable to a requirement? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-004]
- [x] CHK022 Are deletion-protection and removal-on-destroy rules specified per environment (destroy for `dev`, snapshot + protection for `prod`) in the spec rather than only in research? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, Research §R6]
- [x] CHK023 Is encryption in transit between the load balancer and the tasks, and between the API and the database, either required or explicitly accepted as plaintext inside the VPC? [Gap, Spec §NFR-008]
- [x] CHK024 Is log content classified (may logs contain request bodies, e-mail addresses, tokens?) and is the 30-day retention traceable to a requirement? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK025 Is "no real user data in `dev`" operationalised (who may create accounts, whether seed data exists, when the `dev` database may be wiped)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, §Assumptions]

## Non-Production Posture & Supply Chain

- [x] CHK026 Is the `dev` label fully specified (exact title suffix, banner text, position, colour contrast, visible on every page) so UX consistency can be reviewed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Research §R8]
- [x] CHK027 Is the condition under which the label is shown unambiguous when `APP_ENV` is missing (local Docker, tests): shown, hidden, or error? [Edge Case, Research §R8]
- [x] CHK028 Is "exact container images … byte-for-byte" made measurable (digest equality between the scanned artifact, the registry and the running task)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-009, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK029 Are immutable tags and image-scan-on-push stated as requirements, and is the response to a registry scan finding after deployment defined? [Gap, Research §R10]
- [x] CHK030 Is the pinning rule (NFR-005) complete for the new surface: GitHub Actions by version tag or SHA, CDK library, CLI, Node, pnpm, and the synthesized AWS-managed policy IDs? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-005]
- [x] CHK031 Is it specified what happens to the deploy when the expiry of EX-001 passes (which gate blocks `dev`, who flips it)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Constitution §Deployment Environments]

## Cost Controls

- [x] CHK032 Is "at idle" defined (zero requests over the month? one health probe per 30 s?) so the 60 USD ceiling can be measured consistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §NFR-003, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK033 Are both budget thresholds (actual 80 %, forecast 100 %) and the notification channel stated in the spec, and is the e-mail parameter required at synth time? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Research §R13]
- [x] CHK034 Is the behaviour when the budget is exceeded limited to notification (no automatic destruction) and is that explicitly a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK035 Are the free-tier assumptions (content delivery, 12-month database free tier) stated with their expiry, so the cost estimate is not silently optimistic? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Research §R3, §R4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` that the reviewer confirms should become spec or plan text before `/speckit-tasks`
